scientific_integrity: The proof is analytical and supported by supplementary computational checks, but historical priority is not exhaustively established and no independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only reciprocal positive three-node continuous-time Kuramoto coupling, symmetric detunings (-omega,0,omega), finite nonnegative weighting exponents, off-diagonal budget, and local exponential attraction modulo common rotation; no basins, global convergence, arbitrary frequency vectors, or optimal-exponent uniqueness.
title: Budget-optimal locking versus exponentially slow relaxation in a detuned Kuramoto triad
